ijo .mov sama nimi li lon ala
ijo MOV li jo ala e poki ftyp
kama tu li nasin weka; ken ala lukin e ona
sitelen JPEG suli li lon ala
sitelen tawa MP4 pona li lon ala lon monsi JPEG (poki ftyp li lon ala)
sona pi sitelen tawa MP4 li pakala
ijo ni li lili ike; ona li sama ala Live Photo Nubia
nimi nubiaVpfile li lon ala lon pini ijo
suli JPEG lon pini li ike: %1$d
ijo 0x00 li lon ala insa JPEG en sitelen tawa
suli pi sitelen tawa insa li 0
sitelen vivo livephoto li lon ala lon pini JPG
ijo sitelen tawa poka li lon ala: %1$s.mp4
sona pi sijelo JPG li pakala
MP4 poka li pona ala (poki ftyp li lon ala)
sitelen open li HEIC: tenpo ni la sitelen nimi pi wan li lon ala (EXIF pi HEIC li lon Exif item, wile e pali sin); ContentIdentifier li lon poki MOV taso
tenpo sitelen pi Apple li kama: %1$d ms (mebx/elst)
tenpo sitelen pi Apple li lon ala (edit pi mebx/elst li lon ala): tenpo pini la poki li kepeken suli insa pi sitelen tawa
tenpo sitelen %1$d ms li jo ala e poki: Apple lon li kepeken linja mebx; ilo ni li pali ala e ona (still-image-time pi MOV li jo -1)
poki Apple li kama: %1$s + %2$s (ContentIdentifier=%3$s...)
ijo tan kipisi: %1$s (sitelen %2$dB, HDR=%3$s) + %4$s (sitelen tawa %5$dB)
poki Google li kama: %1$s (sitelen %2$dB + sitelen tawa %3$dB)
poki Honor li kama: %1$s (sitelen %2$dB + sitelen tawa %3$dB + EIS %4$dB, LIVE_%5$s)
pali lpex li pakala, pini (ni li ike ala tawa musi): %1$s
poki lpex (LivePhotoExtension) li kama lon moov
poki Meizu li kama: %1$s (sitelen %2$dB + sitelen tawa %3$dB)
poki Nubia li kama: %1$s (JPEG %2$dB + ijo pini 1B + sitelen tawa %3$dB + pini %4$dB, UserComment li jo "%5$s")
poki OPPO li kama: %1$s (sitelen %2$dB + sitelen tawa %3$dB + pini %4$dB)

poki vivo li kama: %1$s.jpg + %1$s.mp4 (nimi livephoto: %2$s)
poki Xiaomi li kama: %1$s (sitelen %2$dB + sitelen tawa %3$dB, EXIF 0x8897=1)
